indicator_name: UAPF pension assets receipts and disposals, year to date: contributions (mandatory, professional, voluntary), investment income, payments
description: Поступления и выбытия пенсионных активов ЕНПФ с начала года: взносы (ОПВ, ОППВ, ДПВ), инвестдоход, выплаты
methodology: NBK formId=25, from 2023-01 (the API keeps no earlier dates), year to date, dated report_date = the first day of the month after the period (the 2025-01-01 point is the 2024 total). IN.CONTRIB.OPV = mandatory 10% employee contributions, a monthly wage-bill proxy (difference consecutive points within a year for the month). The employer contribution (ОПВР, 1.5% 2024 → 2.5% 2025 → 3.5% 2026) is not a separate line of this form.
